tools.name: get_game_details
tools.description: Get details for the currently viewed game on Steam Index, including name, App ID, and Steam Store link.

tools.name: list_sales
tools.description: List current Steam discounts and active game deals tracked by Steam Index.

tools.name: list_top_charts
tools.description: Retrieve the current top played games chart from Steam Index, including rankings, player counts, and 24-hour peaks.

tools.name: open_game
tools.description: Navigate to a specific game details page on Steam Index using a URL or App ID.

url.description: The target Steam Index game page URL.

app_id.description: The Steam App ID of the game.

tools.name: open_steam_store
tools.description: Prepare a safe external handoff link to open the official Steam Store page for the currently viewed game.

tools.name: search_catalog
tools.description: Search the Steam Index catalog for games, DLCs, and applications by keyword query.

query.description: The search keyword (e.g. game title or keyword).
